title: Small locality generators for the relative Ind presheaf conditions
statement:
Use universes, infinite regular cardinals and $\lambda$-smallness from [def-coef-presentable-infinity-category], coherent functors, spaces and limits from [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones], and cocartesian fibrations from [def-coef-infinity-fibrations]. Fix an infinite regular cardinal $\lambda$ in the smaller universe. Let $A$ be a small infinity category and $F_0:A\to\operatorname{Cat}^{\mathrm{rex}(\lambda)}_\infty$ a coherent functor, where the target has small infinity categories admitting $\lambda$-small colimits as objects and functors preserving those colimits as arrows. Let $p:E\to A$ be its small cocartesian fibration, put $E_a=p^{-1}(a)$, and form the relative cone $D=A\amalg_{E\times\{0\}}(E\times\Delta^1)$, with inclusions $j:A\to D$ and $E\times\{1\}\to D$. Write $-\infty_a=j(a)$ and $\mathcal P(D)=\operatorname{Fun}(D^{\mathrm{op}},\mathcal S)$, with $\mathcal S$ the infinity category of small spaces and $y_D(d)=\operatorname{Map}_D(-,d)$.
For $\phi\in\mathcal P(D)$ put $X=j^*\phi$ and $\Psi=\phi|_{E\times\{1\}}$. Its cylinder data define a coherent transformation $\Psi\to p^*X$. Consider the following two conditions: (i) for every cocartesian edge $e\to\alpha_!e$ above $\alpha:a\to b$, the induced square with rows $\Psi(\alpha_!e)\to\Psi(e)$ and $X(b)\to X(a)$ is a pullback of spaces; (ii) the induced functor $E_a^{\mathrm{op}}\to\mathcal S_{/X(a)}$ sends every $\lambda$-small colimit cocone of $E_a$ to a limit cone in the coherent slice, for every $a$.
There is a small set of coherent cocones $r:B_r^{\triangleright}\to D$, indexed by representatives of the squares in (i) and the fiber pushout and less-than-$\lambda$-indexed coproduct tests in (ii), with the common cone point included for the slice tests, such that the maps
$$s_r:\operatorname{colim}_{b\in B_r}y_D(r(b))\longrightarrow y_D(r(\infty))$$
form a small set $S_0$ whose local objects are exactly the presheaves satisfying (i) and (ii). Here $S_0$-local means that precomposition $\operatorname{Map}(y_D(r(\infty)),\phi)\to\operatorname{Map}(\operatorname{colim}_{b\in B_r}y_D(r(b)),\phi)$ is an equivalence for every $r$. Empty coproducts are included, so (ii) requires $\Psi(0_a)\to X(a)$ to be an equivalence for an initial object $0_a$ of $E_a$. All test diagrams and colimits are small relative to the smaller universe; the presheaf category is formed in a containing universe.
